type Good<T extends object> = { [K in keyof T]: T[K] extends infer U ? U : never };
interface Tree<T> { child?: Tree<T>; value: Good<{ label: T }> }
function read(input: { child?: Tree<string>; value: string }): string {
  return input.child?.value.label ?? input.value;
}
